baseline_prompt: Photorealistic clinical dental photography of normal tooth alignment and jaw balance.
mild: Photorealistic clinical dental photography of mild maxillary protrusion, slightly forward upper front teeth.
moderate: Photorealistic clinical dental photography of moderate maxillary protrusion, clearly protruding upper front teeth and overjet.
severe: Photorealistic clinical dental photography of severe maxillary protrusion, strongly protruding upper front teeth with realistic orthodontic appearance.
